newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy shares end slightly weaker, technical market.
newsitem.headline: Italy shares end slightly weaker, technical market.

text.p: Italian stocks ended slightly lower on Thursday after a session of range-trading ahead of the expiry of May options on Friday. U.S. data, including April CPI, was digested as neutral.
Dealers said traded volume was seen fairly healthy around one trillion lire but saw little concrete market direction.
Fiat and telecoms stocks met selling.
The All-share Mibtel index ended off 0.18 pct at 12,404 and the Mib30 blue chip index ended off 0.19 pct at 18,549.
"The Bourse is continuing its sideways movement," one dealer said.
Fiat closed 2.0 percent easier at 55,80 lire, Olivetti was 2.35 percent off at 477 and Pirelli & C down 0.21 percent at 2,420. But bellwether stock Eni gained 1.26 percent to 8,905.
In weaker telecoms, Stet holding lost 1.39 percent to 8,240 lire and Telecom Italia eased 1.09 percent to 4,635.
In banks, Credito Italiano gained 3.19 percent to 2,685 lire and San Paolo put on 1.48 percent to 10,963 despite its upcoming share offering.
Clothing groups Benetton and Stefanel ended lower, at 2.91 percent down to 22,779 lire and 3.25 percent down to 2,559 respectively.
